careers.title: A place where the phone is a craft
careers.lead: What you do here counts. The rest is trainable.

items.title: Training before live calls
items.body: You learn the product and the script before your first call.

items.title: A named team lead
items.body: One person who listens to your calls and helps you improve.

items.title: Progression that exists
items.body: Agent to senior to team lead — a real path.

openings.title: Currently hiring
openings.spontaneousBody: We read every open application, and you are also welcome to just stop by the office.

process.title: How the process runs
process.lead: Four steps, about a week. You will hear back either way.

steps.title: Application
steps.body: A CV and a few lines about why this job.

steps.title: Phone conversation
steps.body: Twenty minutes — it is a phone job.

steps.title: Meeting and trial
steps.body: You meet the team lead and hear real recordings.

steps.title: Offer
steps.body: Written, with the pay structure and a start date.

apply.title: Apply for this role
apply.subject: application
apply.body: Send your CV and a few lines about why this role. We reply to every application, usually within three working days.
apply.note: Your application is used to assess you for this role and is deleted after six months unless you ask us to keep it on file.

sales-agent.title: Sales agent
sales-agent.summary: Outbound calling in Danish. Full training, base salary plus performance pay.
about: You call businesses on behalf of our clients, booking meetings or closing sales.
The phone comes first. It comes down to how you handle the first fifteen seconds.
responsibilities: Make outbound calls to businesses on assigned client campaigns
Book qualified meetings or close sales against written criteria
Log every call and outcome in the client system, accurately and same day
Feed objections and market reactions back to the team lead
Keep your own recordings under review and act on the feedback
requirements: Comfortable on the phone with people you have not met
Able to take a no without taking it personally
Accurate with data entry, because a wrongly logged call costs someone else an hour
Sales experience is welcome but not required, attitude is trainable and taught here

team-lead.title: Team lead
team-lead.summary: Run a campaign team of four to eight agents. Kolding, full time.
about: You own the performance of one or more campaigns — the numbers, the quality and the weekly report.
The job is half coaching, half analysis.
responsibilities: Lead a team of four to eight agents on assigned campaigns
Sample and score calls, and coach individually on what you hear
Own the weekly client report and present it honestly, bad news first
Work with the client on script and segment adjustments
Onboard and train new agents joining your team
requirements: Experience in outbound sales or contact centre work, including time on the phone yourself
Comfortable telling a client something is not working
Able to read campaign numbers and form a view about why
Previous team responsibility is an advantage
